title: Farage senior aide filmed suggesting way to avoid donations law
description: A film broadcast by Channel 4 shows senior Reform UK figures discussing donations with an undercover reporter.

title: Controversial Jackdaw gas field set to be approved in weeks, sources say
description: The government is set to give the go-ahead for the gas field off the coast of Aberdeen, the BBC understands.

title: Transplanted pig kidney works in US man's body for record 271 days
description: A man has lived for a record nine months with a transplanted pig kidney while waiting for a human transplant.

title: Watch: Inside court as Lindsay Clancy's lawyer asks judge to remove juror
description: The jury now faces a seventh day of deliberations in the triple-murder trial.

title: Argentine leader says oil firms working off Falklands face sanctions
description: Javier Milei reiterates his country's claim on the British overseas territory, saying the "winds of change" favour it.

title: Girl group Katseye are missing two members, but their tour still dazzles
description: Reduced but resilient, girl group Katseye received a hero's welcome in London.

title: Volkswagen board approves plan to cut another 50,000 jobs
description: The group - which includes Audi, Porsche, Skoda as well as the VW brand - plans to cut a total of 100,000 by 2030.

title: 'I lost my savings after a job interview scam'
description: Job seekers, especially Gen Z, are being targeted with fake, booby-trapped recruitment apps.

title: Fifa accuses Uefa of 'smear campaign' against Infantino
description: The governing bodies have traded blows since Fifa president Gianni Infantino's scrapped plan to sell off stakes in the World Cup to private investors.
